# konnect_identity_auth_server_trusted_idp (Resource)

IdentityAuthServerTrustedIdp Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_identity_auth_server_trusted_idp" "my_identityauthservertrustedidp" {
  provider = konnect-beta
  auth_server_id           = "d32d905a-ed33-46a3-a093-d8f536af9a8a"
  directory_id             = "1d6e153e-45ec-4b4b-836b-51b3da03a62f"
  id_jag_enabled           = false
  issuer_url               = "https://acme.okta.com/oauth2/default"
  jit_provisioning_enabled = false
  jwks_uri                 = "https://lone-discourse.net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_server_id` (String) The auth server ID
- `directory_id` (String) The Kong Identity directory used for principal lookup and provisioning.
- `issuer_url` (String) The issuer URL of the trusted IdP. Unique per auth server.

### Optional

- `id_jag_enabled` (Boolean) Whether ID-JAG (jwt-bearer) token exchange is enabled. Default: false
- `jit_provisioning_enabled` (Boolean) Whether principals are provisioned just-in-time on first exchange. Default: false
- `jwks_uri` (String) JWKS URI of the trusted IdP. Overrides OIDC discovery when set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) The ID of the trusted IdP.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_identity_auth_server_trusted_idp.my_konnect_identity_auth_server_trusted_idp
  id = jsonencode({
    auth_server_id = "d32d905a-ed33-46a3-a093-d8f536af9a8a"
    id             = "7b5c1c2e-9f3a-4b6d-8e21-0a1b2c3d4e5f"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_identity_auth_server_trusted_idp.my_konnect_identity_auth_server_trusted_idp '{"auth_server_id": "d32d905a-ed33-46a3-a093-d8f536af9a8a", "id": "7b5c1c2e-9f3a-4b6d-8e21-0a1b2c3d4e5f"}'
```
